blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-30. Sole catalogued deployment is Hemi 0x7188…0aa1. Verified source (explorer API) is OpenZeppelin ERC20 + ERC20Burnable + Ownable and states free transferability; onlyOwner mint(address,uint256) is the sole privileged path; burn paths are the stock holder/allowance burns (burn(uint256) present; no burn(address,uint256) onlyOwner seize). At Hemi block 4965111: non-proxy (EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots zero); owner()=Safe 0x3ede…75Be; bytecode lacks pause/paused/isBlacklisted/blacklist/freeze/setOperator selectors. No upstream stablecoin wrapper inheritance. Freeze reach is none; transfer posture is permissionless. Transfer categorical publication still requires chainCirculatingById for material deployment scope. The 2026-10-19 census now assigns 100% of circulation to Hemi, resolving the deployment-scope caveat. Reopened verified VCRED source confirms the only privileged token method is onlyOwner mint(address,uint256), with standard holder/allowance burns and no collateral or redemption implementation. At Hemi block 5543658 (2026-10-19T06:16:47Z), owner() returned 0x3edeef3ae2e9aa5b55e5ce4d324f9c24165c75be. Neither variantOf nor inherited mint parent is declared. The 2026-10-02 reserve review states that the exact Hemi token has no verified reserve assets, custody, weights, or token-to-vault claim. Therefore reserve exposure is unmeasured, bounded 0%-100%, not proven zero and not proven strictly above 50%. Under the strict unresolved-reserve reading, retain No with low confidence pending evidence; do not infer Upstream from missing composition.

branchApplicability.rationale: Source re-observed 2026-10-10T23:32:18Z at the exact Hemi contract's explorer API, which reports is_fully_verified true, proxy_type null and no implementations. VCRED inherits only the supplied OpenZeppelin ERC20, ERC20Burnable and Ownable implementations. Its sole added state-changing function is onlyOwner mint(address,uint256); inherited burn and burnFrom destroy balances without a payout. The complete source contains no collateral valuation, oracle call, NAV, exchange-rate, redemption payout or rebalance authority, so no price-sensitive control exists in this token implementation. The official site's AI/perp vaults remain unjoined to this address. This exact-token applicability finding establishes neither backing nor holder claims on those products. A new supplemental RPC read was unavailable because Hemi has no registered Dwellir endpoint; this review relies on the successfully retrieved fully verified explorer source and does not claim a new pinned runtime observation.
